dct_description_sm: All elicitation materials from session with Nancy Jones on March 4th, 2025. This session begun the investigation into the acceptability of obviative subjects/agents of VTIs, VAIs and VTAs. The attitude verbs were tested by providing a context and test sentences with obviative subjects or agents. The verbs investigated were forget, want, forgive, believe, agree, recognize, hear, perceive, and try.
dct_title_s: Elicitation Materials for Anishinaabemowin Field Methods from March 4th, 2025
